# authwise_issuer_config (Data Source)

An issuer's config: its token lifetimes, CORS, and which realm or realms people sign in to (one of the three provider selectors). Builds the IssuerConfig message and exposes its protojson encoding as `json`, the value `authwise_issuer.config` takes. Makes no API calls.

When a resource named in its arguments has a change planned, Terraform reads this data source at apply rather than at plan, even though every argument is known: `json` shows as (known after apply), and `authwise_issuer.config` plans an update that applies as a no-op when nothing else changed. The function `provider::authwise::issuer_config` takes the same arguments as an object, returns the same string, and is evaluated at plan: use it to keep those plans quiet (Terraform 1.8 or later).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every login goes to one realm.
data "authwise_issuer_config" "this" {
  access_token_expire_seconds = 900

  single_realm_provider_selector = {
    realm_name = authwise_realm.employees.name
  }

  cors = {
    allowed_origins = ["https://app.example.com"]
  }
}

resource "authwise_domain" "this" {
  hostname = "login.example.com"
}

resource "authwise_issuer" "this" {
  domain_id = authwise_domain.this.domain_id
  config    = data.authwise_issuer_config.this.json
}

# An issuer that accepts Claude's client ID metadata documents: a client_id
# that is an https URL on claude.ai is fetched and registered, any other host
# is refused. To accept a document from any https host instead, the
# deliberate open setting, leave trusted_domains out and set
# allow_any_host = true.
data "authwise_issuer_config" "mcp" {
  cimd = {
    enabled         = true
    trusted_domains = ["claude.ai"]
  }
}

resource "authwise_issuer" "mcp" {
  domain_id = authwise_domain.this.domain_id
  config    = data.authwise_issuer_config.mcp.json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token_expire_seconds` (Number) Access token lifetime in seconds. Unset takes the value from the layer above (tenant, issuer, audience, client).
- `account_client_id` (String) The issuer's account-page client: the public PKCE client the account page signs in with.
- `cimd` (Attributes) Client ID Metadata Documents (kit#413): whether this issuer accepts an https URL as a `client_id`, fetching the client's registration from the document at that URL, as MCP clients such as Claude do. Unset is off, and an issuer that never set it plans no change. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cimd))
- `cors` (Attributes) The browser origins allowed to call kit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cors))
- `external_provider_selector` (Attributes) An endpoint decides. At most one of `single_realm_provider_selector`, `multi_realm_provider_selector`, `external_provider_selector` may be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_provider_selector))
- `external_ui_url` (String)
- `flow_integration_config` (Attributes) The endpoint kit calls during the login flow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--flow_integration_config))
- `multi_realm_provider_selector` (Attributes) Identifier-first: the login page asks for an identifier, and ordered rules route it to a realm. kit refuses a selector it could not honour, naming the field. At most one of `single_realm_provider_selector`, `multi_realm_provider_selector`, `external_provider_selector` may be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--multi_realm_provider_selector))
- `persistent_session` (Boolean) Whether the session cookie survives a browser restart: at sign-in it is re-issued to last the session's remaining absolute lifetime (the realm's `session.absolute`). Default false: the cookie ends when the browser closes, the right answer on shared computers.
- `refresh_token_absolute_expire_seconds` (Number) Hard cap on a refresh token family in seconds, set once when the family is created. Unset takes the value from the layer above.
- `refresh_token_expire_seconds` (Number) Refresh token idle lifetime in seconds: it slides forward on every rotation. Unset takes the value from the layer above.
- `remember_identifiers` (Boolean) Whether the login page offers "Continue as b***@acme.com" after the session has ended, from a cookie on the issuer host holding a digest and a masked display form, never the identifier. Unset means on for an identifier-first issuer (`multi_realm_provider_selector`) and off otherwise; set it to say so either way. The cookie proves nothing: every continue runs the realm's whole plan.
- `single_realm_provider_selector` (Attributes) Every login goes to one realm. At most one of `single_realm_provider_selector`, `multi_realm_provider_selector`, `external_provider_selector` may be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--single_realm_provider_selector))

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The protojson encoding of IssuerConfig, for `authwise_issuer.config`.

<a id="nestedatt--cimd"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cimd`

Optional:

- `allow_any_host` (Boolean) Accept a document from any https host, the MCP "open server" posture: the deliberate way to open the issuer to every host, and the only one. kit refuses it beside a non-empty `trusted_domains`, and refuses `enabled` with neither, at apply.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Accept URL-form `client_id`s. Default false.
- `trusted_domains` (List of String) The hosts whose documents are accepted, matched exactly against the URL's host: lower case, no port, no wildcard. Required while `enabled`, unless `allow_any_host`: CIMD fails closed, so turning it on never opens the issuer to every host by leaving the list empty.


<a id="nestedatt--cors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cors`

Optional:

- `allowed_origins` (List of String) Origins allowed to call kit from a browser.
- `allowed_origins_regexp` (List of String) Origin patterns allowed to call kit from a browser.


<a id="nestedatt--external_provider_selector"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_provider_selector`

Optional:

- `endpoint_name` (String) The endpoint's full resource name.


<a id="nestedatt--flow_integration_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `flow_integration_config`

Optional:

- `endpoint_name` (String) The endpoint's full resource name (`tenants/{t}/endpoints/{e}`).


<a id="nestedatt--multi_realm_provider_selector"></a>
### Nested Schema for `multi_realm_provider_selector`

Optional:

- `default_target` (Attributes) Where an identifier that matches no rule goes. Required by kit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--multi_realm_provider_selector--default_target))
- `identifier` (Attributes) The identifier screen. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--multi_realm_provider_selector--identifier))
- `realm_names` (List of String) The realms this issuer serves, as full resource names. Every target must name one of them.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Ordered; the first match wins. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--multi_realm_provider_selector--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--multi_realm_provider_selector--default_target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `multi_realm_provider_selector.default_target`

Optional:

- `provider_name` (String) A provider in that realm. Unset, the realm's own selection applies.
- `realm_name` (String) The realm, one of `realm_names`.


<a id="nestedatt--multi_realm_provider_selector--identifier"></a>
### Nested Schema for `multi_realm_provider_selector.identifier`

Optional:

- `kind` (String) `EMAIL` (the default when unset), `USERNAME` or `ANY`.
- `label` (String) The field's label. Unset follows `kind`.


<a id="nestedatt--multi_realm_provider_selector--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `multi_realm_provider_selector.rules`

Optional:

- `condition` (String) CEL over `identifier`, `local_part` and `domain` returning a bool. With `domains`, both must hold.
- `domains` (List of String) Exact (`partner.example`) or subdomain (`*.partner.example`) domains, lower-case A-labels, matched against the part of the identifier after its last `@`.
- `name` (String) Unique within the selector, and recorded as `routing_rule` on each login's audit row.
- `target` (Attributes) Where a matching identifier goes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--multi_realm_provider_selector--rules--target))

<a id="nestedatt--multi_realm_provider_selector--rules--target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `multi_realm_provider_selector.rules.target`

Optional:

- `provider_name` (String) A provider in that realm. Unset, the realm's own selection applies.
- `realm_name` (String) The realm, one of `realm_names`.




<a id="nestedatt--single_realm_provider_selector"></a>
### Nested Schema for `single_realm_provider_selector`

Optional:

- `realm_name` (String) The realm's full resource name, e.g. `authwise_realm.x.name`.
